name: dsh-evoforge
description: Native out-of-tree plugin suite installed into DeepSeek Harness

scripts.generate:typert: pnpm --filter dsh-evolve exec tsc -b ../../tsconfig.host.json --force && pnpm --filter dsh-evolve run prune:types && node scripts/generate-typert.mjs
scripts.test:cache-contract: pnpm --filter dsh-evolve exec vitest run test/generation-binder.e2e.test.ts -t "turns a natural-language native Goal into a durable model-declared Capability Gap" && pnpm --filter dsh-github-review exec vitest run test/cache-composition.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers 1 && pnpm --filter dsh-goal-continuity exec vitest run test/cold-resume.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers 1 && pnpm --filter dsh-software-delivery exec vitest run test/dsh-assembled-skill.e2e.test.ts test/dsh-assembled-completion.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers 1 && pnpm --filter dsh-feishu exec vitest run test/full-channel-cache-composition.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers 1 && pnpm --filter dsh-doctor exec vitest run test/suite-native-plugin-contract.test.ts --maxWorkers 1
scripts.test:pa1: pnpm --filter dsh-evolve exec vitest run test/auto-promotion-policy.test.ts test/auto-promoter.test.ts test/automatic-evaluator-draft.test.ts test/automatic-evolution-budget.test.ts test/automatic-evolution-inflight.test.ts test/automatic-feedback-shadow.test.ts test/automatic-retention.test.ts test/retention-evidence-index.test.ts test/candidate-impact.test.ts test/sealed-trial-darwin.e2e.test.ts test/shadow-resume.e2e.test.ts test/feedback-shadow-launcher.test.ts test/generation-store.e2e.test.ts test/evaluator-draft-inbox.test.ts test/evaluator-authoring-crash.e2e.test.ts test/retention-gate.e2e.test.ts test/review-inbox.test.ts && pnpm --filter dsh-software-delivery exec vitest run test/verify-delivery.test.ts test/complete-delivery.test.ts test/draft-pr-check-wait.test.ts && pnpm --filter dsh-github-review exec vitest run test/config.test.ts test/review-selection.test.ts test/runtime.test.ts && pnpm --filter dsh-evolve-web exec vitest run test/evolution-action.client.test.tsx && pnpm --filter dsh-telegram exec vitest run test/protected-route.test.ts test/telegram-api.test.ts test/inbound.test.ts && pnpm --filter dsh-evolve-attention exec vitest run test/attention.test.ts test/bridge.test.ts && pnpm --filter dsh-goal-continuity exec vitest run test/goal-continuity.test.ts && pnpm --filter dsh-resident exec vitest run test/deployment.test.ts
scripts.benchmark:hermes: pnpm benchmark:hermes:ev1 && pnpm benchmark:hermes:sd1 && pnpm benchmark:hermes:lc1 && pnpm benchmark:hermes:as1
scripts.test: pnpm -r --filter '!dsh-telegram' --filter '!dsh-feishu' test && pnpm --filter dsh-telegram test && pnpm --filter dsh-feishu test
scripts.check: pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
